# Product map: a business as shifts × paths

*Template created 2026-10-28 by Evolver from PST 174 (Sasha, 2026-10-28: «Карта продуктов - это фазовые сдвиги × реплицируемые и упрощенные пути их реализации»). Builds on [shift-offer.md](./shift-offer.md): each lit cell of the map is one Shift Offer. Written for a founder-led transformation business like ours, and usable for any unique business, whether its niche is shifts of consciousness or of physical reality.*

## Meta-description

## 1. Essence
**Every unique business is a unique product map.** It specialises in a niche of shifts (of consciousness or of physical reality). Its products are **shifts × replicable, simplified paths** that deliver them. One shift can have several paths of different depth (a video, a game module, a session); one path can carry several shifts. **A product is a cell; the map is the business.**

## 2. The niche of shifts
Name the niche before listing anything.

```
## Niche of shifts: <business name>
- Kind: consciousness | physical reality | both (say which shifts are which)
- The niche in one sentence: <the territory of shifts this business owns>
- Who walks through these shifts: <the person, in the words they use about themselves>
- Not ours: <adjacent shifts we deliberately leave to others>
```

- A shift of **consciousness** changes what a person sees (a gap named, a talent articulated, a pattern recognised).
- A shift of **physical reality** changes something in the world (a first sale made, a body healed, a house built, a stall opened).
- Many businesses carry both; name them separately so each row knows what its check looks like.

## 3. Rows and columns

### 3a. Rows: the shifts
One row per shift. Use a library number where one fits honestly; otherwise write it as a **candidate** (a real seeing with no library name yet, a library candidate for Sasha, meta-template §7.8).

| Row | Shift (PST N name, or candidate) | Before → after (one line) | Core? |
|---|---|---|---|
| S1 | | | yes / no |

*Core* = a shift the niche is built on. Non-core rows may stay thin.

### 3b. Columns: the paths, by depth
One column per path, ordered from light to deep. Example columns (adapt to the business):

| Depth | Path | What it is | Replicable and simplified when… |
|---|---|---|---|
| light | **Video** | a short recorded episode or broadcast | it runs without the founder live (course-from-source.md) |
| light–mid | **Game module** | one place: Intro → one button → result → Outro | it follows module-form.md and works alone |
| deep | **Session** | 1:1 with the founder or a trained guide | it follows a written script (session-script.md) another guide could run |
| deep, held | **Mastermind / circle** | a group holding one shift over days | it has a fixed run-of-show and integration days |

- **Replicable:** it can be run again and again without being re-invented.
- **Simplified:** one path does one thing; if it needs a long explanation, split it.
- A business in physical reality will have its own columns (a guide, a kit, a workshop day, a build); the rule is the same: ordered by depth, each one replicable and simplified.

## 4. The matrix
Each cell is a **Shift Offer** ([shift-offer.md](./shift-offer.md) §3) or empty.

```
| Shift ↓ / Path → | Video (light) | Game module | Session | Mastermind (deep) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| S1 PST N <name>  | —             | <offer name> → offer sheet | — | <offer name> |
| S2 candidate: …  | ...           | ...         | ...     | ...               |
| Craft (no shift) | ...           | ...         | ...     | ...               |
```

- A filled cell names the product as the buyer sees it and links to its Shift Offer sheet (or to the section where its offer line, A, B and check are written).
- An empty cell is written as **—**. It is a choice not yet made, not an error.
- A path that carries several shifts appears in several rows; mark the main one (●) and the secondary ones (○), so the offer line follows the main shift.
- The **Craft** row holds paths that carry no shift (a tool, navigation, a service). They stay on the map, honestly, with no "you will see".

## 5. Checks
Run all four every time the map changes.

1. **Every path carries at least one named shift.** Read each column top to bottom: a path whose only cell is in the Craft row is Craft, and is sold as a skill or service (shift-offer.md §8).
2. **Every core shift has at least a light and a deep path.** Read each core row left to right: no light path = no door in; no deep path = no place where the shift is held and where the price lives (shift-offer.md §7, price by depth of shift, not volume of content). Name the missing cell as the gap.
3. **A cell with no real shift is marked Craft.** Do not force a technology onto a cell to make the map look full. A real seeing with no library name goes in as a candidate, not as Craft and not as a forced PST.
4. **Every filled cell has a check the person runs themselves** (shift-offer.md §4.6). A cell without one keeps its offer line as an invitation, not a promise, and lists the gap.

What the checks produce: a short list of gaps, each one a cell: "S3 has no light path", "the Video column carries no shift yet". The next product to build is chosen from that list (by the founder).

## 6. Worked example: FindYourTopTalent's own map
*Read only from `docs/02-strategy/game_of_being_you.md` §17 (Shift offers per module, 2026-10-27). Nothing is added that §17 does not say; no prices and no new products. Columns are the paths §17 actually names: game modules, the real-world quests on the Quest Board, the `/ignite` session and the Mastermind. §17 names no video path, so the Video column is empty.*

### 6a. Niche
- **Kind:** both. Consciousness (a person sees their top talent, their uniqueness, their pattern) and physical reality (they say a price, receive a first payment, open a stall).
- **In one sentence (reading of §17, for Sasha to rewrite):** shifts from "I can't say what makes me me" to a business that is unmistakably theirs and paid for in the world.

Offer lines for each cell are in §17 (e.g. J1: "You will see your top talent named in one sentence that fits only you, and you will step into the village as yourself."; `/ignite`: "You will see your lifelong pattern as a one-sentence business you recognize as yours, and you will send your first message before we hang up."; J9: "You will see your next move clearly, held by a circle for a full week, and you will take it in the real world before the week is out.").

### 6c. What the checks show (reading of §17)
1. **Every path carries a named shift:** yes for every column except Video, which has no path at all in §17. J4 QoL Map, J10 and Oracle (AI OS) sit in the Craft row, as §17 marks them.
2. **Light and deep paths per core shift:**
   - PST 158 has both: J7 tagline (light) and J9 Mastermind (held). This is the row where one shift already has paths of different depth.
   - PST 5 has J1 as its main path and is carried as a secondary shift by the Oracle Reading; no session or circle carries it on the map.
   - PST 125 has only the deep path (`/ignite` session); no light path leads into it on the map.
   - Most other rows (e.g. PST 94, PST 89, PST 10, PST 38, PST 102) have one main path each, all in the game or the quests.
   Which shifts are core is the founder's call; the map only shows the gaps.
3. **Craft marked honestly:** yes; QoL Map is kept as a candidate shift, not forced.
4. **Self-checks:** §17 lists a check for each filled cell; its gaps (missing 1–10 on Outros, real-world quests not built, Mastermind checkout) carry over unchanged.

Not on the map because §17 gives them no shift yet: J3 Spectrum Reading, J13 Town Hall (PST 166 is named there only as a design law), J8 Webinar (waits for Sasha's plan; its tentative PST 53 line is marked not for use in §17), and the frame (Title, Village map, Tutorial lore), which §17 marks Craft with no offer line.

## 7. Open edges
- Which shifts are **core** for FindYourTopTalent: the founder's.
- The Video column: §17 names no video path; whether course-from-source episodes become paths for existing rows is open. First cell in production (2026-10-28, Sasha's yes): PST 5 × Video, a 60–90 s Explainer ending at `/ignite`, made with NotebookLM from a one-source script.
- Licensing a cell to a community host (one shift × one path, with its offer sheet, script and self-check): offer draft in `docs/02-strategy/unique-businesses/alexanders_unique_business.md`, Product Map §8. Split TBD by Sasha.
- Whether places of the game (Quest Board, Café, Co-working, Your House) count as products on the map or as the frame; they are shown here because §17 gives each an offer line.
- Prices per cell follow shift-offer.md §7; live prices and checkout stay with Sasha.
